verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is that a user can switch into a team workspace so their conversations are "protected under business plan terms" with "enterprise-grade privacy protections." That is an indirect, plan-gated control, and none of the docs say whether these protections cover model training. missing for 10: an explicit training opt-out setting for individual users, documentation stating that business-plan conversations are excluded from training, coverage of consumer plans, and independent corroboration.
